title: Sampling of Human Islets for Quality Control Purposes
author: James Lyon
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bupbnvin
materials: To 800 mL of Milli-Q water add the following reagents and allow to mix into solution. The citric acid will not completely go into solution until the pH is set to 7.4 3.15 g Sodium Citrate Dihydrate 8.77 g Sodium Chloride 1.01 g Disodium EDTA Bring to volume with Milli-Q water and set the pH to 7.4. Aliquot the Citrate buffer into 50ml conical tubes and store at -20 °C . Thaw the buffer as needed and store at 4 °C .
Acid/Ethanol solution Add the following reagents in a sealed glass bottle. Store at 4 °C prior to use. 150 mL 95% ethanol 47 mL acetic acid 3 mL concentrated hydrochloric acid

steps.title: Suspend Islet Preparation
steps.instruction: Suspend the islet preparation in a known volume of culture media (typically 50ml x2 for 100ml total volume).

substeps.instruction: Use a 25ml pipette and pipette aid to completely suspend the islet preparation by gently pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Collect Sample for Islet Equivalent Count
steps.instruction: Remove one 50 µL sample from the centre of the islet suspension using a pipette with a wide bore ART® 200G Self-Sealing Barrier Pipet Tip.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the sample to a petri dish for an islet equivalent count (to be performed twice on the same sample).

steps.title: Collect Samples for DNA and Insulin
steps.instruction: Remove 4x 50 µL samples from the centre of the islet suspension using a pipette with a wide bore ART® 200G Self-Sealing Barrier Pipet Tip.

substeps.instruction: Transfer each sample to a 5ml polypropylene tube (2 for DNA, 2 for insulin).

steps.title: Process DNA Samples
steps.instruction: Process the two samples designated for DNA from the previous step.

substeps.instruction: Add 4.5 mL citrate buffer to each sample.
Remove all resulting supernatant from the pelleted islets using an aspirating pipette and pipette tip.
Label the sample tubes with the internal identifier number (Rxxx), sample number (1 or 2), and sample date.
Cap and store the sample tubes at 4 °C until dsDNA assay.

steps.title: Process Insulin Samples
steps.instruction: Process the two samples designated for insulin from the previous step.

substeps.instruction: Add 950 µL of Acid/Ethanol solution to each sample.
Label sample tubes with the internal identifier number (Rxxx), sample number (a or b), and sample date.
Cap and store the sample tubes at -20 °C to await insulin assay.

steps.title: Process Histology Sample
steps.instruction: Remove one 500 µL sample from the islet suspension using a pipette with an ART® 1000G Self-Sealing Barrier Pipet Tip and transfer to a 5ml polypropylene tube labelled with the internal identifier number (Rxxx).

substeps.instruction: Add 4.5 mL PBS to the 500 µL sample and allow the suspension to settle to a pellet for at least 00:05:00.
Remove the supernatant and add 500 µL of Z-fix.
Transfer to a 1.5ml Eppendorf tube and store at 4 °C overnight.
Remove the fixative, add 500 µL PBS, and store at 4 °C to await processing.
Embed fixed islet sample in low melt agarose and submit to histology core for processing to paraffin-embedded blocks and sections.
Store all returned blocks and slides in the histology library.
